titleEn: Catching Up with an Old Friend
description: 偶遇老朋友，怎么自然接上话、讲一段近况、把叙旧变成下一次见面，而不是只剩寒暄。

targetChunks.note: ages = 很久；比 Long time no see 更 native，也更轻松。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It's been ages! You look exactly the same.

targetChunks.note: 重逢时的友好客套，语气轻松；别用于刚认识的人。
targetChunks.exampleEn: You haven't changed a bit — still wearing that same jacket.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你一点没变，还穿着那件夹克。

targetChunks.en: What have you been up to?
targetChunks.note: 问近况最自然的一句；比 What are you doing now 更口语。
targetChunks.exampleEn: So what have you been up to? Last I heard you were in Shanghai.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 最近在忙什么？我上次听说你在上海。

targetChunks.note: 对近况不确定时的自然回答；比 I don't know what I'm doing 体面。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Honestly, I'm still figuring things out.

targetChunks.en: Work's been keeping me on my toes.
targetChunks.zh: 工作一直让我忙得团团转。
targetChunks.note: keep someone on their toes = 让人保持紧张/忙碌；比 I'm busy 生动。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Work's been keeping me on my toes, but in a good way.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 工作一直让我忙得团团转，不过是好事。

targetChunks.en: I ended up taking a job in Shanghai.
targetChunks.note: end up + doing = 出乎意料的结果；讲故事时很常用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I ended up taking a job in Shanghai, completely out of the blue.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我最后去上海工作了，完全没想到。

targetChunks.note: 对方刚提到某事、正好和你要说的有关时接话；比 What a coincidence 更口语。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Funny you should mention that — I'm moving there next month.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你说巧不巧，我下个月就要搬过去。

targetChunks.en: Long story short, it's been a roller coaster.
targetChunks.note: roller coaster 形容起伏；跳过细节、给情绪定调。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Long story short, it's been a roller coaster, but I'm settling in.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 长话短说，像坐过山车，不过我在慢慢适应。

targetChunks.en: I'm terrible at keeping in touch.
targetChunks.note: 自嘲式社交表达；重逢时用来化解「怎么这么久没联系」的尴尬。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm terrible at keeping in touch — that's on me.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不太擅长保持联系，这怪我。

targetChunks.en: We should do this more often.
targetChunks.note: 聚会收尾的友好表达；比 Let's meet again 更自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: We should do this more often — I've missed this.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我们该多聚聚，我挺怀念这种感觉的。

targetChunks.en: Let's not leave it so long next time.
targetChunks.note: leave it so long = 拖这么久才联系；比 Don't disappear again 温和。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's not leave it so long next time.

targetChunks.en: I'll take a rain check on that.
targetChunks.note: rain check = 改日再约；轻松拒绝邀请，不伤感情。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll take a rain check on tonight, but let's do next week.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 今晚我去不了，改天吧，下周可以。

roleplay.promptZh: 你在街上偶遇多年未见的朋友。自然接上话，聊聊近况和一段小故事，最后约下一次见面。
roleplay.promptEn: You run into an old friend you haven't seen in years. Catch up naturally, tell a short story, and make a plan to meet again.
goals: 用 It's been ages 自然开场
用 Long story short 讲一段近况
把叙旧收成下一次见面

script.speaker: you
script.en: It's been ages! You haven't changed a bit.

script.speaker: other
